comment: I don't believe she was as nice as others have said, she could be very passive aggressive towards all students. I also believe we had to do most of the learning on our own because she was not the best at teaching in class. I was able to end with a decent grade but it was due to doing a lot of work on my own time.

Professor Bagranoff is a very kind accounting professor and makes accounting interesting. The class is mostly lecture-based though there is class-participation during the practice problems. She is very accessible outside of the classroom and is always happy to answer questions about the material. Tests are similar to the practice problems.
This class was very average. If you do bad on one test good luck getting your grade up.

Professor Bagranoff is so well versed in the world on accounting. She is passionate, caring, and always loves sharing antidotes from her personal life. The class really is reliant on the two midterms and final though, and chances are if you do poorly on one midterm it will greatly affect your final grade. I would still take her again though!

Dr. Bagranoff is passionate about accounting and tries to keep everyone on their toe. She covers the essential materials in class with real-world examples, but you have to read the textbook to get a more detailed understanding of every chapter. Half of the classes are about reviewing every HW question assigned, which can be boring.
She is an excellent professor. She is always willing to help students and makes sure everyone is staying on top of their work. Highly recommend her!
Get ready to read because the course is very heavy. We have to read one chapter every lesson and do assignments. Tests were not the hardest but she gives lots of pop quizzes

Prof. Bagranoff knows ACCT so well that sometimes she would go over things fast that you would feel lost. She's a great person, but personally, I wasn't a fan of her teaching style. You should read the textbook even though she goes over the most important material in class. The exam questions are easier than the practice questions in the textbook.

Took my first accounting course with Professor Bagranoff and I had no regrets. Coursework was pretty light, and homework was optional, although you do need to study on your own to achieve a high grade. She was very accessible outside of class; as a very experienced professor, she was a great resource. Would definitely take her again!

Tries her best to provide students with the material and resources to do well. The subject will be very difficult no matter the professor but she really tries to help her students by providing examples and extra problems. She can be kinda blunt and standoffish at times but she is a good professor.

Overall a good professor. The class is pretty difficult overall. A lot of things to memorize and prepare for but she provides you with a lot of practice material and is pretty generous with her grading.

Prof. Bagranoff was awesome! This was my 1st college course. Taught the material in a very comprehensive manner that complimented HW readings. ACCT is relatively bland subject to me, but prof. made it very interesting. Highly respected for her experience as an accountant and dean of Bus school for 8 years. Read, take notes, listen, learn, succeed.
